events.title: The Pier at Dawn
events.text: Fog hangs over a quiet fishing harbour as the first boats leave. Harbourmaster Eli Okoro checks the night log.

events.title: The Discovery
events.text: A dockworker finds the body of shipping clerk Marcus Vale at the end of Pier Nine. The police are called.

events.title: Harbourmaster Eli Okoro
events.text: The calm, watchful harbourmaster who keeps the night log and was the last to see Marcus Vale alive.

events.title: Filming location
events.text: This opening sequence was filmed on location at a working fish dock; the background extras are real dockworkers.

events.title: Detective Dana Rios
events.text: The detective assigned to the case. She was Marcus Vale's former partner on the force before he left to work at the docks.

events.title: Rios Takes the Case
events.text: Detective Rios arrives at the pier, recognises the victim, and insists on leading the investigation despite the conflict of interest.

events.title: Alibi
events.text: A claim by a suspect that they were somewhere else when the crime happened.

events.title: Tomas Vale
events.text: Marcus Vale's younger brother. He says he was at a card game all night, but cannot name who was there.

events.title: Shipping manifest
events.text: The official list of every item loaded on a ship. Marcus kept the manifest for the night cargo.

events.title: The Missing Page
events.text: Rios discovers that one page of the night shipping manifest has been torn out of Marcus's ledger.

options.label: Looks like someone has been fishing for trouble.
Lagta hai kisi ne jaan-boojh kar museebat mol li hai.
Parece que alguien andaba buscando problemas.

events.title: Real rain
events.text: The heavy rain in this scene was real; the crew shot it in one night and the actors improvised the umbrella exchange.

events.title: The Confrontation
events.text: Rios confronts Tomas Vale about the torn page. He denies it, but his card game alibi falls apart.

events.title: Nadia Fenn
events.text: A local journalist who has been investigating smuggling through the harbour for months.

events.title: Dead drop
events.text: A secret location where items or messages are left for someone else to collect, so the two never meet.

events.title: Costume detail
events.text: Detective Rios's coat was sewn from the same wool used for the original harbour police uniforms of the 1970s.

events.title: The Reveal
events.text: Nadia Fenn reveals that Marcus was copying shipping records to expose a smuggling ring run from inside the harbour office.

options.label: Original line: "He was never going to stop digging."
Alternate line: "He trusted the wrong people."
Alternate line: "He knew exactly what it would cost him."

events.title: Red herring
events.text: A misleading clue that distracts from the real answer. Tomas's missing alibi turns out to be one.

events.title: Cameo
events.text: The harbour clerk in this scene is played by the film's location manager, in a one-line cameo.

events.title: Aftermath
events.text: Okoro is arrested at the harbour office with the missing manifest page. Rios finally closes her former partner's case.

options.label: Original closing shot: Rios walks the empty pier.
Alternate closing shot: Rios lights a candle on Pier Nine.

events.title: Score
events.text: The closing music was recorded in a single take using a foghorn as one of the instruments.
